wizard.chapter1.consume_chicken: That little creature still has life in it. Take it, if you can.
wizard.chapter1.kill_knight: The guard will not move for a starving shadow.
wizard.chapter1.choose_host: Power is borrowed here. Choose a body and survive the cost.
wizard.faction.wizard.start: Magic opens doors that steel cannot see.
wizard.default: The air bends strangely around you.

elf.chapter1.consume_chicken: You look like a rumor that forgot how to stand.
elf.chapter1.kill_knight: The knight blocks the only honest road out.
elf.chapter1.choose_host: If you take a shape, remember that shape had a life before you.
elf.faction.elf.start: The forest remembers every army that crossed it.

knight.chapter1.consume_chicken: Back, thing. You are too weak to pass.
knight.chapter1.kill_knight: Then prove you can wear violence better than hunger.
knight.chapter1.choose_host: Armor is not loyalty. It is only weight.
knight.faction.knight.start: The city still needs soldiers, even broken ones.

dwarf.chapter1.consume_chicken: You need meat before you pick fights with iron.
dwarf.chapter1.kill_knight: Knights love narrow passages. Makes them feel like walls.
dwarf.chapter1.choose_host: A borrowed body still has bones. Try not to waste them.
dwarf.faction.dwarf.start: Stone keeps secrets better than people do.
dwarf.default: If you are buying, talk. If not, move.
